# National Geographic Education

> A comprehensive STEM and science education platform offering live virtual events, interactive resources, and expert-led learning experiences for K-12 students.

National Geographic Education provides educators and students with free interactive learning resources, including live events with National Geographic Explorers, virtual field trips, and hands-on STEM activities. The platform emphasizes experiential learning and connects students directly with scientists, journalists, and conservation experts working in the field.

## Key Topics

- STEM Education
- Virtual Events
- Live Interactive Learning
- National Geographic Explorers
- K-12 Resources

## Live Events & Expert Encounters

- [Life in Hot Water](https://education.nationalgeographic.org/event/life-in-hot-water): Virtual event with biologist Rosa Vásquez Espinoza exploring microbes in freshwater ecosystems.
- [Planet of the Snails and Spiders](https://education.nationalgeographic.org/event/planet-of-the-snails-and-spiders): Live interactive event with conservation biologist Martina Panisi on invertebrates and biodiversity.
- [Documenting Environmental Resilience in Africa](https://education.nationalgeographic.org/event/documenting-environmental-resilience-in-africa): Earth Day event with photo-artist Miora Rajaonary on Great Green Wall landscape restoration.
- [Engineering Adventures In Space](https://education.nationalgeographic.org/event/engineering-adventures-in-space): STEM live event with NASA systems engineer Tracy Drain on space exploration and engineering.
- [Stories on Foot](https://education.nationalgeographic.org/event/stories-on-foot): Educational event with journalist Paul Salopek on the Out of Eden Walk storytelling project.
- [Unhidden Voices of History](https://education.nationalgeographic.org/event/unhidden-voices-of-history): Storytelling event with journalist James Edward Mills uncovering overlooked community histories.

## Platform Overview

- [Education | National Geographic Society](https://education.nationalgeographic.org): National Geographic education platform with live events, maps, videos, and interactive STEM resources.
